main_text.head: ACTVS SECVNDVS.
ABRAHAMVS.
main_text.p: QVum mira nobis Cælitum clementia Donarit, Vxor, filium, quo tempore Effæta iam senecta nullam liquerat Spem prolis amplius, superesse simul Vt illius conemur indolem bonis Formare moribus tenellam, & Numinis Almi timore Vero, Vt ocyus malos Cætus nefariorum, & improba Vitet Contagia turbæ: testa nam quibus est recens Imbuta odores seruat: & corrumpere Ingenia cerea in Vitium flecti nihil Magis potest, scelecтa quàm confortia, Turpique blandus ore sermo profluens. Et ceu laboribus subactas sedulis Fæcundiores terra fructus procreat: Sic cura si Vigil parentum liberos Excolat, & artibus statim melioribus

page.notes: Ornamental woodcut band below the epigraph; the first word of the verse paragraph is a large decorated initial Q joined to "Vum" (Quum). Some words are blurred; "sceleftas" and "scelesta" read as printed. Several lines of the verse begin with a large initial and may be uncertain in spelling.
